text:
lauren: quick heads-up — found a regression in the traffic-sim snippet in the dedicated-provisioning docs, looks like autoscale policy yaml uses old cooldown key
samir: ah, where's the snippet? PR?
lauren: PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4123 :eyes: i pushed a small change but the simulation results disagree with local dev runs
mara: can you paste the failing snippet and the cli command you used to run the sim?
lauren: sure. command i used: `./bin/sim-traffic --config examples/dedicated/autoscale-sim.yaml --seed 42`
lauren: snippet (from docs):
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 10
  scale_out_cooldown: 120
  scale_in_cooldown: 300
  isolation_labels: ["tenant:default"]
```
ben: looks like the config key we read is `cooldown_seconds` in runtime, not `scale_out_cooldown`/`scale_in_cooldown` — mismatch causes no scale-out during bursts
mara: that would explain distribution skew in sims :grimacing:
samir: can we update the docs snippet to the runtime schema and add a note about labels vs decorators? small PR should be fine
lauren: updated the PR with new snippet and a short migration note, but CI docs lint is failing (yaml lint error)
ben: yaml fix: use array for isolation_labels rather than bracket shorthand? also indent on `isolation_labels:`
ben: corrected snippet I pushed to branch:
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 10
  cooldown_seconds:
    scale_out: 120
    scale_in: 300
  isolation_labels:
    - tenant: default
``` 
docs-bot: deploy-preview created: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/docs/dedicated/autoscale-sim-4123
mara: i'll run the sim on preview and compare to prod baseline, will post numbers in thread
samir: also add a tiny SDK snippet showing `AutoscaleConfig.from_yaml(...)` — will help users migrating programmatically
lauren: ack, adding SDK snippet now, will ping for quick review. thanks y'all :rocket:
